data.summary_en: SCOPE addresses coarse-grained supervision in long-horizon agent RL via policy analysis of trajectories and on-policy self-distillation at selected error steps, with bounded signed teacher-student coefficients and length rewards. ALFWorld and WebShop: Qwen2.5-3B achieves 97.7% and 85.2% success, beating SEED by 5.9 and 6.3 percentage points.
